answer: Staggered Arrival Delta.** Each identity must submit its first action within a unique, randomly assigned slot; the platform measures the delta between request arrival and slot center and rejects bursts exceeding a fixed deviation. An attacker cloning identities pays for parallel traffic shaping plus wasted registrations on rejected slots. A prism check splits each slot into sub-windows so synchronized floods reveal their common nebula of origin timing, forcing costly per-identity desynchronization.
